releaseTitle: ATalk v3.11.1 — Telegram Tap Context Menu, Edge-to-Edge Canvas & Sleek Navigation
releaseNotes:
• 01 Telegram-Style Message Tap Context Menu: Instant message tap brings up horizontal reaction pill (❤️, 🔥, 🤯, 😂, 💋, 👍, ⌄) and an attached compact action menu (Reply, Pin, Copy Text, Forward, Delete, Report, Select, Save to Saved Messages, Save to Hidden Safe).
• 02 Edge-to-Edge Full Wallpaper Canvas: Completely removed top/bottom black borders on both Chat List and Chat Room screens, rendering the glowing signature AGSL wallpapers continuously across the entire display.
• 03 Lengthened Command Dock: Upgraded the bottom navigation bar to span 92% screen width with balanced equal-weight tabs (Chats, Status, Calls) and micro-haptic switches.
• 04 Sleek Navigation Drawer Overhaul: Replaced isolated boxy cards with an authentic luxury drawer layout, rich gradient profile header with live E2EE keystore status, unified grouped list tiles with soft tinted squircle icon badges, and quick panic lock.
• 05 Settings Consolidation & Live Wallpaper Studio: Harmonized notification previews and incognito masking, added Covert Notification Disguise personas to Stealth settings, and integrated the live AGSL Wallpaper Studio directly into Appearance settings.
